title: Local finite-free lifts through epimorphisms of module-valued sheaves
statement: Let C be a small category with Grothendieck topology J, B a commutative ring, T an object of C, and r a nonnegative integer [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Let p:F -> G be an epimorphism of B-module-valued sheaves, and phi:constant(B^r) -> G a sheaf morphism [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. There is a covering sieve S on T such that, for every f:U -> T in S, the restriction of phi lifts through p|U as a sheaf map psi:constant(B^r) -> F|U on C/U [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. More precisely psi followed by p|U equals phi|U precomposed with the canonical constant-sheaf restriction isomorphism. Rank zero and empty covering members are allowed; no Noetherian or points hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 094G, lemma-locally-constant, lifting finite top-cohomology generators (the source omits the details)

proof.text: Let eta be the original morphism from the constant presheaf B^r to G, obtained by precomposing phi with the constant-sheafification unit [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. At T evaluate eta on each standard basis vector. An epimorphism of module-valued sheaves is locally surjective by Mathlib Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi'. Its image sieve for each of these finitely many sections is covering. Their finite intersection S is covering [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology].

source.place: Tag 094G, lemma-locally-constant, lifting finite top-cohomology generators (the source omits the details)

proof.text: For each f:U -> T in S, choose preimages z_i in F(U) of all the restricted basis-image sections. The standard basis of B^r [def-weil-pbc-free-module] extends i -> z_i uniquely to a B-linear map l:B^r -> F(U). This includes r=0, when the covering intersection is the maximal sieve and l is the zero map.

source.place: Tag 094G, lemma-locally-constant, lifting finite top-cohomology generators (the source omits the details)

proof.text: The constant-sheaf adjunction on C/U [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-pur-localized-ringed-site] turns l into psi:constant(B^r) -> F|U. To compare psi followed by p|U with the restriction of phi, apply this adjunction, which is a bijection on Hom sets. Compatibility of the constant-restriction map with the sheafification unit identifies the second adjunct with eta at U. The first adjunct is l followed by p(U).

source.place: Tag 094G, lemma-locally-constant, lifting finite top-cohomology generators (the source omits the details)

proof.text: These two linear maps agree on every standard basis vector: the preimage equation gives p(U)(z_i)=G(f)(eta_T(e_i)), and naturality of eta gives G(f)(eta_T(e_i))=eta_U(e_i). Basis extensionality gives equality of linear maps, and the adjunction gives the asserted equality of sheaf maps. No nonempty-slice, Noetherian or points hypothesis has been used.

mathlib_searches.results: Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi and SheafOfModules.freeHomEquiv supply ingredients; no single theorem states this constant-module local lifting and its restriction compatibility.
The local-surjectivity definition and epi characterizations, but no finite-free constant source lifting statement.

The sites source search finds local section lifting terminology but not the finite-free source morphism lifting theorem. The project finite-free internal Hom exactness theorem uses the ringed-module encoding, not this constant ModuleCat-valued signature.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_local_lift_from_constant_finite_free
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] (T : C) (r : ℕ)
    (F G : Sheaf J (ModuleCat.{u} B)) (p : F ⟶ G) [Epi p]
    (φ : (constantSheaf J (ModuleCat.{u} B)).obj
      (ModuleCat.of B (Fin r → B)) ⟶ G) :
    ∃ S ∈ J T, ∀ ⦃U : C⦄ (f : U ⟶ T), S f →
      ∃ ψ : (constantSheaf (J.over U) (ModuleCat.{u} B)).obj
          (ModuleCat.of B (Fin r → B)) ⟶ (J.overPullback (ModuleCat.{u} B) U).obj F,
        ψ ≫ (J.overPullback (ModuleCat.{u} B) U).map p =
          constantSheafOverHom J (ModuleCat.{u} B) U
            (ModuleCat.of B (Fin r → B)) ≫
              (J.overPullback (ModuleCat.{u} B) U).map φ
